content.p: i've had a few people ask me about making tabs. there's an easy way to do it with css, using...

ul.li: url hashes — the text after a "#" in the url, usually used to auto-scroll to an element with a matching id
:target — a css pseudo-class that selects the element referenced by the url hash

content.p: here's an example. say i want to navigate between a set of tabs, with only one visible at a time.

links can direct to url hashes like any other url; clicking a link with href="#id" will append the hash "id" to your url. i can give each of my tabs a unique id and set up a corresponding link for each, like so...
